quests.name: Salt and Secrets
quests.summary: The third shard went south to Saltmere, and a Syndicate fence sold the rest of the heart-stone to someone he is afraid to name.

stages.text: Saltmere runs on bargains that are never written down. The shard went to a fence called Osk Dray, but nobody will tell a stranger where to find him. Someone in this port will know how to get an introduction.
stages.objective: Find out who in Saltmere can arrange a meeting with the Syndicate

stages.text: The Syndicate runs its business from Marrow & Daughters, a counting house near the market. Its mistress, Ines Marrow, decides who may see Osk Dray, who works for her, and who does not leave.
stages.objective: Meet Ines Marrow at the Counting House, or find another way to Osk

stages.text: Osk Dray keeps his strongroom beneath the quays, behind a black oak door. The shard is in a lacquered box inside, and Osk is not the sort to give it up for free.
stages.objective: Get the salt shard from Osk Dray

stages.text: The shard is in your hand, but it was only a chip of the whole. The heart-stone itself was sold to someone, and the answer is in Osk's ledger, or in Osk himself.

on_complete.message: Lord Varric Caul, Regent of Vael, has the heart-stone. Everything you have been told about the Queen's death was a lie. And the road east, to the Ashen Marches, leads to the only men who might be willing to say so to his face.

quests.name: Deserters on the Salt Road
quests.summary: Harbourmaster Voss wants the deserters on the salt flats dealt with, one way or another.

stages.text: Deserters from the Regency's garrison are robbing salt-carts on the flats. Voss does not much care how they are dealt with, only that it is done before the autumn caravans.
stages.objective: Deal with the deserters on the salt flats

stages.text: The salt road is quiet. Voss should hear how.
stages.objective: Tell Harbourmaster Voss the road is safe

quests.name: A Pearl for Teodora
quests.summary: Teodora's sister is marrying, and wants a perfect grey-green pearl from the flats.

stages.text: Teodora's sister Annick marries at the next tide, and the only gift that would please her is a pearl from the cloudy pan on the salt flats.
stages.objective: Bring Teodora a brine pearl from the salt flats

quests.name: Relight the Lamp
quests.summary: Old Mab wants the crabs in the lighthouse cellar cleared so the lamp can be lit again.

stages.text: Two brine crawlers have made a nest in the lighthouse cellar and eaten the lamp-oil. Mab will relight the lamp if they are gone.
stages.objective: Clear the brine crawlers from the lighthouse cellar

stages.text: The cellar is quiet. The lamp can be lit.
stages.objective: Tell Old Mab the cellar is clear

quests.name: A Song Without a Name
quests.summary: Sable was left on the Saltmere quay as a baby, with a silver moth brooch and no explanation. They want to know who left them, and they would rather not look too hard.

stages.text: Sable was found as a baby in a herring crate on the Long Quay, wrapped in a grey cloak with a silver moth pinned to it. The old lighthouse keeper, Mab, was the one who found them.
stages.objective: Ask Old Mab at the lighthouse who left Sable on the quay

stages.text: Mab remembers a woman in a moth-grey cloak, weeping, who paid Marrow's clerk and left on a north-bound barge. Whatever she wrote, Ines Marrow kept it.
stages.objective: Get the letter from Ines Marrow

stages.text: The letter is sealed. Sable has never wanted to read it. Perhaps it is time.
